pending.title: Your organizer account is waiting for approval
pending.create: You can create and publish events once an admin approves your account. We’ll notify you as soon as that happens.
pending.events: You will see your events here once an admin approves your account. Until then you can’t create or publish events.
pending.dashboard: Creating and publishing events is switched on after approval.

rejected.title: Your organizer account was not approved
rejected.create: Events can’t be created or published from an account that was not approved. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
rejected.events: Your events can’t be changed because the account was not approved. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
rejected.dashboard: Events can’t be created or published until the account is approved.

suspended.title: Your organizer account is suspended
suspended.create: Events can’t be created or published while the account is suspended. Contact support to find out what is needed to lift it.
suspended.events: Your events can’t be changed while the account is suspended. Contact support to find out what is needed to lift it.
suspended.dashboard: Events can’t be created or published while the account is suspended.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.subtitle: Your events, their review status and your sales.
dashboard.salesNote: All time, from paid orders. Refunded orders are not counted. Detailed sales, attendees and payouts come with the sales screens.
dashboard.salesError: We couldn’t load your sales figures.
dashboard.noUpcoming: No approved event is coming up. Approved events with a future date appear here.
dashboard.noneYet: Your upcoming events will appear here once your account is approved.
dashboard.ordersSoonText: The backend has no list of orders across your events yet, so this card stays empty for now.

list.title: My events
list.subtitle: Every event you created, with its review status.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, venue or city
list.cap: Only the first {{limit}} events of this status are searched and listed.

empty.title: You haven’t created an event yet
empty.text: Start with a draft. You can save at any step and submit it for review when it’s ready.

none.title: No events match
none.text: Try another status or a different search.

error.title: We couldn’t load your events
error.text: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

form.firstDraftHint: The first draft needs an event name, a category, a venue and dates. Fill those in and use Save draft or Continue.
form.leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page and lose them?

submitted.title: Submitted for review.
submitted.text: An admin will check it. You’ll get a notification when it is approved or if something needs fixing.

details.title: Event name (English)
details.titleHint: {{min}} to {{max}} characters. Shown on the event page and on tickets.
details.descriptionHint: Optional. {{min}} to {{max}} characters ({{count}} so far). What happens, how long it runs, what guests should bring.
details.english: Write the name and description in English here. Korean, Russian and Uzbek come in the Translations step.

images.rules: JPG or PNG, up to {{size}} MB each, at least {{width}} × {{height}} px, up to {{max}} images.
images.none: No images yet. At least one is needed to submit.
images.hint: The first image is the cover. Keep the subject near the centre so it survives the different crops. Avoid text in the image: it can’t be translated.
images.max: You can add up to {{max}} images.
images.small: is {{dimensions}} px. {{width}} × {{height}} px or larger looks sharper. It was added anyway.

problem.type: isn’t a JPG or PNG image.

venue.createLater: Can’t find your venue? Creating venues is coming in the next update.
venue.noLayout: No seat map, general admission only
venue.seating: How do guests get a place?

seatingText.RESERVED: Guests pick exact seats on the venue’s seat map. Each tier of the map has its own ticket type and price.
seatingText.GENERAL: No assigned seats. Guests choose a quantity and you set how many tickets are available.

venue.reservedUnavailable: This venue has no seated section, so it can only host general admission events.

locked.approved: The venue and the seating type are locked because the event was approved: its seats and orders belong to them.
locked.tickets: The venue and the seating type are locked because ticket types already exist for this event. Ticket types can’t be deleted.

venue.zone: Times are in the venue’s time zone: {{zone}}.
venue.zoneUnknown: Choose a venue first: times are read in the venue’s time zone.

tickets.introGeneral: Add one ticket type per price: for example Standard and VIP. Guests choose a quantity, and you set how many are available.
tickets.introReserved: Each tier of the venue’s seat map has one ticket type. You set the name and price; the quantity is the number of seats and can’t be changed.
tickets.approvedNote: Ticket changes of an approved event apply right away and do not send the event back to review.
tickets.pickVenue: Choose a venue with a seat map in the previous step to see its tiers.
tickets.name: Name
tickets.quantityMin: At least {{count}}, the number already sold.
tickets.pause: Pause sales of this ticket type
tickets.untouched: Add a price to create this ticket type. Tiers without a price are skipped when you save, but every tier needs one before you submit.
tickets.noDelete: Saved ticket types can’t be deleted. Pause one to stop selling it.
tickets.commission: Buyers pay exactly the price you set. Ticketzy’s commission is taken out of your payout, not added on top. Prices are in Korean won (₩).
tickets.saleWindowHint: Optional. Leave empty to sell from approval until the event. Times are in the venue’s time zone.

translations.intro: The event is written in English. Add Korean, Russian and Uzbek so every visitor reads it in their language. A language left empty falls back to English.
translations.title: Event name, {{language}}
translations.fallback: A language needs a name to count as filled in. Descriptions without a name are not saved.

review.fixErrors: Some fields need attention. Fix them before submitting.
review.after: An admin reviews every event before it goes on sale. After you submit, the status changes to In review and the event is locked until the admin decides.

errors.title: Use 3 to 100 characters.
errors.description: Use 5 to 2,000 characters, or leave it empty.
errors.tooMany: You can add up to 8 images.
errors.noLayout: This venue has no seated section. Choose general admission or another venue.
errors.startRequired: Enter a start date and time.
errors.endRequired: Enter an end date and time.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end can’t be before the start.
errors.incomplete: Enter both a date and a time, or clear both.
errors.saleEndBeforeStart: The sales end can’t be before the sales start.
errors.ticketPrice: Enter a price in won as a whole number. 0 means free.
errors.ticketMax: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.ticketQuantity: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.belowSold: This can’t be lower than the number already sold.

ai.needTitle: Add an event name of at least 3 characters to translate it.
ai.notSaved: AI suggestions are only shown for you to review. Nothing is filled in or saved until you accept it.
ai.manual: You can still write the translations yourself.
ai.createFirst: Save the draft first (Save draft below), then translate.
ai.saveFirst: Fix the highlighted fields and save the draft first, then translate.
ai.saveFirstApproved: Save your changes to the event first, then translate. The AI reads the saved English text.
ai.reviewText: Read each language before you use it. Artist names, dates and venue names are the usual mistakes.

errors.disabled: AI translation isn’t available on this server.
errors.rateLimited: You’re using AI too fast. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.failed: The AI couldn’t answer right now. Try again later.
errors.busy: The AI is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalid: The AI’s answer couldn’t be used. Try again.

submit.title: Submit for approval?
submit.intro: An admin will check the event before it goes on sale. We check these first:

check.title: The event has a name
check.dates: Start and end are in the future
check.layout: The venue has a seated section (reserved seating)
check.tiers: Every seated tier has a ticket type

submit.after: After you submit, the status becomes In review and the event can’t be edited until the admin decides. If it is rejected, you’ll see the reason and can fix it and submit again.

cancel.title: Cancel this event?
cancel.intro: This is what happens when an approved event is cancelled:

points.closed: The event is closed for good. It leaves the public pages, can’t be edited or re-opened, and its sales stop.
points.refunds: Every paid order is refunded in full automatically, in batches. The normal refund deadline does not apply.
points.used: Tickets that were already checked in are refunded too.
points.notices: Each buyer gets a “refund completed” notification and you get one summary of how many orders were refunded and how many failed.
points.retry: An order that fails to refund stays paid and an admin can run the refunds again.
points.stock: Seats and tickets do not go back on sale.

cancel.unavailableTitle: You can’t cancel an approved event yourself yet.
cancel.unavailableText: Contact Ticketzy support with the event name and the reason. An admin cancels it, and the steps above run automatically.

rejected.title: This event was rejected.
rejected.noReason: The admin did not give a reason.
rejected.next: Fix it and submit it again.

pending.title: In review.
pending.text: An admin is checking this event, so it is locked. You’ll be notified when it is decided.

approved.title: This event is approved and on sale.

points.content: Name, category, description, images, dates, sale window and translations can be edited, but saving any of them sends the event back to review and takes it off sale until it is approved again.
points.tickets: Ticket types (name, price, how many, pausing) apply right away without a new review. You can’t go below the number already sold.
points.locked: The venue and the seating type are locked, because seats and orders belong to them.
points.seats: For reserved seating the quantity comes from the seats and the tier can’t change.

cancelled.title: This event was cancelled.
cancelled.text: It can’t be edited. Paid orders were refunded.

rereview.title: Send this event back to review?
rereview.text: Saving changes to an approved event needs a new review:

points.offSale: While it is in review the event is not public and nobody can buy tickets.
points.tickets: Tickets that were already sold stay valid.
points.again: You’ll be notified when an admin approves it again.

notFound.title: Event not found
notFound.text: It may have been removed, or it belongs to another organizer.
